$comment: Shoelace role-map — Task 4 of docs/plans/2026-08-21-families-a11y-composition-plan.md (§4).
Maps each of Shoelace's 58 custom elements to its nearest WAI-ARIA role. A small
pre-pass (scripts/derive-admits.mjs) expands this map x the brand-agnostic ARIA
composition table (docs/a11y-foundation/composition-rules.json: required-owned /
required-context / presentational-children + the interactive-content set) into per-
component `admits` blocks, written into inputs/cem/config/slots.json in the SAME shape
as html's config: { <slotName>: { kinds: [...], multi: bool } }. The emitter then
flattens those admits -> slotKinds exactly as it does for html; ValidSlotKind is untouched.
KIND TOKENS are the generated component ctor names (camelCase): `menuItem`, `tabGroup`,
`radioGroup`, `treeItem`, etc. — the same identifiers that appear as `component = "..."`
in Sl/Review/Facts.elm. Bare tokens name a single kind; `@<set>` a category; `!@<set>`
/ `!<kind>` subtract (D-FAM2).
Each entry's `role` is the ARIA role Shoelace's own component implements internally
(Shoelace manages role/aria-* on the host — the docs say you do not add role yourself).
`role: "none"` marks a component with no clean single ARIA role (card, divider, the
formatters, the observers, decorative/utility elements). Those fall back to a permissive
content model (`@any` minus `!@interactive` where the component is itself interactive).
`admits` overrides on an entry pin a slot's child-set where it is Shoelace-specific and
NOT derivable from the role alone — the canonical case being sl-tab-group, whose tabs go
in the `nav` slot and whose panels go in the default slot (verified against the live
shoelace.style/components/tab-group docs, 2026-08-22). When present, an override REPLACES
the role-derived admits for that slot; slots not named keep the role default (or, for a
container's default slot, the required-owned expansion).
Provenance: ARIA roles cross-checked against shoelace.style component docs + the CEM slot
definitions on 2026-08-22. required-owned/required-context table: the Task-1 foundation.
$comment_sets: Category sets over the 58 shoelace ctors, mirroring html's _sets discipline.
`interactive` = shoelace components that are themselves an interactive control
(focusable widget the user operates) — used as the `!@interactive` subtrahend on
permissive containers so an interactive control cannot nest another interactive
control (the a11y rule html's button/a already needed). `phrasingLike` = the inline,
non-container display atoms a text-ish slot may hold.

sl-alert.note: status/alert live region; default slot holds phrasing/flow message content.

sl-animation.note: wrapper that animates a single slotted child; no ARIA role of its own.

sl-breadcrumb.note: breadcrumb trail; default slot holds sl-breadcrumb-item.

sl-breadcrumb-item.note: a link/label within the breadcrumb trail (ARIA maps the trail, not the item, to a role).

sl-card.note: plain container per plan §4; permissive content model.

sl-carousel.note: roledescription carousel; default slot holds sl-carousel-item.

sl-color-picker.note: composite color input; slots hold only a label.

sl-details.note: disclosure; summary slot is the toggle, default slot the disclosed content.

sl-divider.note: presentational separator; per plan §4 no clean owned content — empty content model (no slots).

sl-dropdown.note: positioning primitive: trigger slot = an interactive control, default = usually sl-menu.

sl-include.note: fetches + injects HTML; no authored content model.

sl-input.note: form control; slots hold only label/help/affordances, not arbitrary content.

sl-menu.note: required-owned menuitem; shoelace also allows menu-label + divider.

sl-menu-item.note: required-context menu; presentational-children; itself interactive. submenu slot nests a menu.

sl-menu-label.note: non-interactive label row within a menu.

sl-mutation-observer.note: behavioural wrapper; observes its slotted subtree; permissive.

sl-popup.note: low-level positioning primitive; permissive default + anchor slot.

sl-radio-button.note: button-styled radio; required-context radiogroup; itself interactive.

sl-radio-group.note: required-owned radio; shoelace admits sl-radio OR sl-radio-button.

sl-range.note: presentational-children; itself interactive; slots hold only label/help.

sl-rating.note: star-rating slider; presentational-children; itself interactive; no content slots.

sl-resize-observer.note: behavioural wrapper; observes its slotted subtree; permissive.

sl-select.note: listbox popup owns option; shoelace admits sl-option + divider.

sl-spinner.note: indeterminate busy indicator; presentational-children; no slots.

sl-split-panel.note: resizable start/end panes; permissive per-pane content.

sl-tab.note: required-context tablist; presentational-children; itself interactive; lives in tab-group's nav slot.

sl-tab-group.note: required-owned tab — BUT shoelace puts tabs in the `nav` slot and panels in the default slot (verified against live docs 2026-08-22).

sl-tab-panel.note: content pane bound to a tab by name; permissive flow content.

sl-textarea.note: form control; slots hold only label/help.

sl-tooltip.note: default slot = the anchor element, content slot = the tip text.

sl-tree-item.note: required-context tree; default slot nests child sl-tree-item recursively (plus its own label text/display content).
